sql: with r as (select row_number() over (order by posted_at, id) n, labels, sensitive from social_mentions) select bool_and(case n when 1 then 'khen' = any(labels) when 2 then 'hoi_suc_khoe' = any(labels) and sensitive when 3 then 'hoi_gia' = any(labels) when 4 then 'hoi_ruou' = any(labels) when 5 then 'khieu_nai' = any(labels) when 6 then 'nghi_hang_gia' = any(labels) end) from r
select count(*) from social_mentions where excerpt is not null
select count(*) from social_mentions s where row_to_json(s)::text ~ '0900000|Khách Thử IT|uid-it'
select count(*) from intel_imports where kind = 'social'
